newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 977 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 977 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 977 contracts compared with 2,179 overnight Tuesday.
There were 11 wheat, 726 corn, 229 soybean, one soymeal, four soyoil, one oat, two corn calls and three soybean calls traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was one cent higher to 3/4 cent lower, corn was 1/4 to 1-3/4 cents lower and soybeans were one cent lower to one cent higher.
